answer: Farming becomes a terrace bet on surviving 94 epochs of grading, and every horizon settlement recomputes the ember schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 94 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 9 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
